summary: an SB16 boot like the audio suite's: the scale recorded from QEMU's SB16 and judged by wavcheck, at the host's speed and under an instruction clock of 512 ns an instruction, at which the device plays periods of the buffer again

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/wavcheck && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

faults.name: rate
faults.summary: the SB16's 44100 Hz rate taken out of audio_debug.c, so `audio test scale` cannot start the audio

lines: sb16-proof: fail: host: the boot, status 1
sb16-proof: fail: slow: the boot, status 1

faults.name: refill
faults.summary: sb16.c filling its buffer from the ring and never from the callback, so the scale reports a stall

lines: sb16-proof: fail: host: the boot, status 1
sb16-proof: fail: slow: the boot, status 1

faults.name: stereo
faults.summary: the stereo bit left out of the DSP's mode, so the device plays each channel's sample as a frame of its own and wavcheck finds the tones an octave low
